q: We just got scored on and our 5 is taking the ball out. What spacing do we run up the floor?
answer: 5 Out, with the 5 trailing (Big Above)
wrong: 4 Out, with the 5 rim running (Big Ahead)
Walk it up and wait for a call
explain: Closest Man Inbounds: if the 5 inbounds, he trails and we are 5 Out.

q: Someone other than the 5 inbounds after a make. What does the 5 do?
answer: Rim runs (Big Ahead) and we set 4 Out
wrong: Sets a Drag screen at half court
explain: If anyone else inbounds, the 5 rim runs and we play 4 Out.

q: Pace 21: by when does the ball need to be across half court?
answer: 21 seconds on the shot clock

q: You're the Deep Outlet. Where do you catch the ball?
answer: Butt to the sideline at free-throw line extended
wrong: Inside the key, facing the inbounder
At the top of the key in the backcourt
explain: Sneak a peek down court to see numbers before you receive the pass.

q: Where does the Dunker sit?
answer: Short corner: heels on the baseline, outside the hash, opposite the ball
wrong: On the block, same side as the ball
In the deep corner behind the 3-point line
At the elbow, facing the ball

q: After a defensive miss, our trailing big sets a transition ball screen right away. What is that called?
answer: Drag

q: What is "77"?
answer: Double Drag: staggered transition ball screens, O5 sets the second one
wrong: A single Drag set by the 4

q: Race: what are we hunting in the first 6 seconds?
answer: Layups, 3s or fouls

q: The defence has all 5 back, loaded to the ball, and the ball defender is square to the handler. We are…
answer: Neutralized: flow straight into a Core Trigger
wrong: In transition: keep attacking the rim
In Flow: play off the last action
Out of time: just get a shot up

q: Core call "2" means…
answer: Stagger

q: Core call "1" means…
answer: 5 Out Single Pin

q: Core call "4" means…
answer: 4 Out DHO into Step Up

q: The point guard twirls his finger ("Motion"). What are we running?
answer: Continuous PNR

q: Who makes the Early Call, and what does he decide?
answer: The point guard: 4 Out or 5 Out, are we neutralized, which Core Trigger
wrong: The 5: which side to post up
The coach: every set from the bench
The first wing: whether to shoot

q: You drive and two defenders come to you (E2). What do you do?
answer: Pass quickly to the open teammate
wrong: Pick up the ball and pivot out

q: You drive the paint and kick it out. What's your next job?
answer: Exit cut out faster than you came in (Kick Out Get Out)
wrong: Stay in the paint for the rebound
Set a screen for the shooter

q: The defence is scrambling. How long do you have to shoot, drive or pass?
answer: Half a second (.5)

q: Drive & Kick order of attacks: 1st side, 2nd side, 3rd side?
answer: Trigger, then 2-man game, then flash or snap
wrong: 2-man game, then trigger, then post feed
Post feed, then skip, then trigger

q: Drive, kick out, then one more quick pass to punish the rotation. What's that?
answer: Drive Kick Swing (the extra pass)

q: You come off the ball screen and nobody engages you. Your read?
answer: Score
explain: Score: no one engages the handler. Search: E2 engages. Skip: tags collapse.

q: Off the ball screen two defenders engage you (E2). Your read?
answer: Search: find the roll or the pop

q: In the PNR, the weak-side tags collapse on the roll. Your read?
answer: Skip to the open shooter
wrong: Throw it to the roller anyway

q: Their big is in drop. Which is one of our counters?
answer: Hang: float dribble to freeze the drop big

q: The ball defender goes under the screen. What do we do?
answer: Twist (re-screen) or race the under to the paint
wrong: Pass back to the top and reset

q: They ICE our side ball screen. What does the screener do?
answer: Slip roll: dive straight to the rim

q: They switch the ball screen with a soft switch. Our first attack?
answer: Race the switch: drive it downhill
wrong: Post up the guard every time
Reset and run a new action

q: A small guard ends up guarding our big. We call…
answer: Mouse in the House

q: Their big ends up guarding our guard on the perimeter. We call…
answer: Moose on the Loose

q: Where do we screen to force the defender over the top?
answer: The lower third of his body

q: You catch in the post. What are your first three things?
answer: Catch on 2 feet with 2 hands, chin it, check your inside shoulder
wrong: Hold it high and wait for the double

q: The post has no advantage. What's the call?
answer: Blast: DHO uphill, then slip or pop
wrong: Force the shot over the top
Kick it back to the feeder and stand

q: You feed the post. What cut do you make?
answer: Speed cut: baseline side, to the rim, out to the opposite corner
wrong: Stand and wait for the kick out
Cut to the elbow and screen
Back cut to the same corner

q: The shot goes up. Who gets back?
answer: The 2 guards (2 Back), through the elbows if in the corner

q: What's the latest point we pick up the ball in transition D?
answer: The 4-point line or higher

q: D-Trans: what do we take away in the first 6 seconds?
answer: No key, no free 3s
wrong: No fouls on the shooter only

q: In transition you're stuck in a mismatch and a teammate pulls you out. That's…
answer: SCRAM

q: Closeout on a KLAY (knockdown shooter)?
answer: Fly by: run at his shooting shoulder with your shooting hand
wrong: Stop short and absorb the drive
Stay in the paint and help

q: Closeout on a SHAQ (driver, not a shooter)?
answer: Absorb the drive: give him space, no paint
wrong: Close out to his body with high hands

q: Which three rules go with every closeout?
answer: Stick hand, no strong hand, no paint

q: You're guarding the player next to the ball. Your role in the shell?
answer: STRONG: shrink and stunt
wrong: NAIL: take the first pass out

q: You're the top weak-side defender. Your job?
answer: NAIL: sink on baseline or slot drives, you have the first pass out
wrong: Stay attached to your man at the 3-point line

q: What are our shrink spots (B.E.N.)?
answer: Blocks, Elbows, Nail

q: Shell Defense motto?
answer: Force tough 2s: one & done

q: Side ball screen on the outer third of the floor, call is ICE. Guard's job?
answer: Keep the ball from going middle (the big drops)
wrong: Go under and let him shoot
Double the ball with the big

q: The big calls "RED". What happens?
answer: Contact switch on the screen
explain: RED = switch. The screener's man calls it early.

q: What is HOT?
answer: Blitz: hard double on the ball until he picks it up or retreats

q: The 5 Ts of ball-screen defence are…
answer: Talk, Touch, Trace, Take, Tag

q: In DROP, where does the big play?
answer: Centerfield between the ball and the rim
wrong: Up at the level of the screen
In the corner with the shooter

q: TALK: who calls the coverage, and how?
answer: The big, early and 3 times ("DROP", "ICE", "RED")
wrong: The guard, once, after the screen
The coach from the bench only

q: GOLD is our base post coverage. What is it?
answer: 3/4 top denial, slide behind on the pass

q: The post catches and puts it on the floor. Who digs?
answer: The closest perimeter defender, on the dribble bounce
wrong: The defender guarding the passer, on the catch

q: NO MIDDLE in post D means…
answer: Sit on his inside shoulder, feet pointed to the sideline
wrong: Front him from the baseline side
Let him go middle into help

q: End of game, we're up 2. Screens?
answer: Stay before the inbound, switch everything after

q: End of game, we're up 3. Screens?
answer: Switch before and after, and chop (foul) when possible to stop a 3
wrong: Drop the big and protect the rim

q: When do we CHOP (intentional foul)?
answer: Up 3 late, or end of quarter when we have a foul to give
wrong: Any time they're in the bonus
On every drive in the last minute
